ngaap.guidance_text: Fiscal 2027 Outlook Mr. Lisman stated, "We are issuing full year fiscal 2027 guidance today, which reflects our current expectations for the year. We are well-positioned for continued growth as we head into our fiscal 2027 across all three of our primary end markets." TransDigm is issuing fiscal 2027 financial guidance to be as follows: • Net sales are anticipated to be in the range of $11,950 million to $12,150 million compared with $10,557 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 14% at the midpoint; • Net income is anticipated to be in the range of $2,442 million to $2,490 million compared with $2,108 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 17% at the midpoint; • Earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $42.06 to $42.91 per share based upon weighted average shares outstanding of 56.7 million shares, compared with $35.51 per share in fiscal 2026, which is an increase of 20% at the midpoint; • EBITDA As Defined is anticipated to be in the range of $6,195 million to $6,345 million compared with $5,563 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 13% at the midpoint (corresponding to an EBITDA As Defined margin guide of approximately 52.0% for fiscal 2027); • Adjusted earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $47.09 to $47.94 per share compared with $41.35 per share in fiscal 2026, an increase of 15% at the midpoint compared to prior year; and • Fiscal 2027 outlook is based on the following market growth assumptions: ◦ Commercial OEM revenue growth in the high single-digit to low double-digit percentage range; ◦ Commercial aftermarket revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range; and ◦ Defense revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range. Please see the attached Table 6 for a reconciliation of EBITDA, EBITDA As Defined to net income and reported earnings per share to adjusted earnings per share guidance midpoint estimated for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027. 3
